🌙✨ Welcome to the Midnight Bazaar — HQ for the workspace's food culture! ✨🌙

This channel was born from all the food chatter scattered across our channels — turns out we've been building a night market without even realizing it:

🍜 Kenji kicked things off in #engineering wondering if anyone else forgets to eat during crunch weeks, and floated the idea of a team food rotation.
🍯 Olena shared homemade Ukrainian honey cake in #general — proof that the best snacks come from grandma's recipe box.
☕🍕 Lukas and Mateo turned a dying espresso machine in #random into a full-blown lunch summit — French press vs. espresso, 3 large pizzas from Valencia, garlic knots, and a side of ramen for good measure.
🥐 And Sophie's French press masterclass reminded us that good coffee is basically a productivity multiplier.

So let's make it official: the Midnight Bazaar is where all that scattered food energy finds a home. Street food stalls, coffee corners, late-night snack swaps — bring your cravings, your recipes, and your hot takes on pizza toppings.

First order of business: what stall would YOU run at the bazaar? 🍢🥟🌮
